[I83] 【他】越来越喜欢祭拜   correction: 他 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here. items.explanation: 孟子 is already clear from the previous clause, so 他 is redundant. Chinese uses zero form here.

In 不是……而是……, put the Subj. before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. 他 is redundant, so use zero form.
不是……而是…… must refute an expected idea and give its correction. Here the reason for 祭拜 should be 喜欢祭拜, not 喜欢画画.
It would be more natural to add 了: becoming a famous ancient painter is a completed change in the story, so it can take 了completed/change.
